title: CHORDS (scale-aware chords)
author: stephen
description: Scale-aware chords for the Digitone mk1 and Digitone Keys, on a third AMP page, Chords: CHRD and VOIC, kept in the sound and p-lockable like any stock knob. CHRD KEY makes the chords a trig holds (the Note Add menu's MAJOR, MINOR, DOM. 7TH ...) follow the track's keyboard ROOT and SCALE, so a MAJOR shape on D in C major plays D minor; TRI, SUS2, SUS4, 6TH, 7TH, 9TH and ADD9 do that and also make each single-note trig that chord in the key. VOIC: CLS, INV1-3, OPEN. Needs core-dn1 3.3 and seq-events.
